title: chart-hypothesize
intention: Stage 6 of the /chart chain: the HYPOTHESIZE brick. One narrow question: what do we EXPECT of each ranked piece, and how would we know we're wrong? Not what the pieces are (decompose), not their order (triage), not what done means for the whole (validate — the next brick). Every HYPOTHESIS attaches to a ranked piece verbatim and carries expect + falsifier + instrument; every ranked piece carries at least one (a covering). Three strata: FLOOR — template-filled from the berthed triage packet (the chain deepens to depth 6: hypothesize -> triage -> decompose -> survey -> constrain -> orient, re-checked whole by composing triage's own chain reader BY IDENTITY — each stage owns exactly one new link), handing the ceiling the intent, the bounds, the order verbatim, the underlying split pieces (kind and evidence), and the judges' vocabulary (ranked_whats — the exact set the covering must cover); TREE — the hypothesize brick's own corpus through the generalized verbs; CEILING — the expectations themselves, per-field provenance. Built UNDER the pre-installed judges (ticket hypothesize-filters): the berth door composes judge_hypothesize by identity; the module cannot shape its own acceptance.
why: Hypothesize is where Law 3 stops being a labeling discipline and becomes the packet's shape: the build that follows will either confirm or kill each expectation, and a kill with a named instrument is a FINDING, not a surprise. The dated failures: 2026-07-27 '0 of 13' (instrument unnamed, claim unchallengeable), 2026-07-26/27 wrong-about-the-world mornings (expectations never instrumented), and the falsifier-defect proof lessons (pinned-cursor, coin-toss-red). The stage also feeds the tester's future: a hypothesis with instrument named is a proof waiting to be written.
traces_to: Law 3 — nothing is known until measured; the stage emits the labels the law demands, per piece
Law 1 — the expectations are compiled once, before the build, instead of re-derived in each session's head
Law 4 — the judges + schema make an unmeasured or unfalsifiable claim a build error, not a lapse
Law 8 — the brick's first berthed packet passes judges it did not write (hypothesize-filters, the live gate)

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: test_chart_hypothesize.py (chain physics at depth 6 — refuses without a readable triage berth, and a broken link anywhere below refuses loudly; floor hands the covering vocabulary verbatim from the berth; schema gate refuses hollow shapes; door composes judge_hypothesize BY IDENTITY; berth round-trips; deposit-back gated; import allowlist over import_map) under the tester's netns seal. Live gate: a real hypothesize packet for THIS ticket berths through judges the module did not write, deposits back, and registers on the dial.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: stage 6 filling from the conversation instead of the berthed stage-5 file; the floor re-walking the chain in parallel instead of composing triage's reader; a packet leaving a ranked piece unhypothesized, attaching to an invented piece, or carrying a claim without falsifier+instrument passing the door; the door and the promotion gate disagreeing; the dial unable to read a hypothesize berth; the deposit-back seeding the tree with a packet whose berth is not on disk.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when validate lands (stage 7 template-fills from this berth); when a real crossing needs integration-level hypotheses (hypothesize-filters edge (b) — a design event); when /moreabout signals show hypothesize fields recurrently too compressed.
